endings.title: ✅ ENDING 1: CLAIM APPROVED (80%+)
endings.summary: Every verification check—from identity and CPT codes to provider NPI and policy benefits—matched your dossier! Your claim is fully approved with zero delays.

endings.title: ⚠️ ENDING 2: SEMI-APPROVED (50% – 79%)
endings.summary: Most of your information checked out, though one or two mismatched details require follow-up documentation before full reimbursement is released.

endings.title: 🛑 ENDING 3: CLAIM DENIED (Below 50%)
endings.summary: Too many verification mismatches occurred during the call. Your claim has been denied and will need to be corrected and resubmitted.
